# Python Analyzer

This module provides a comprehensive analysis of Python source files, extracting deterministic facts about components, symbols, dependencies, and API endpoints. It integrates with the tree-sitter parsing library to accurately process Python syntax, enabling the identification of functions, classes, and various decoratative constructs.
